title: Reading Drill — Using Chalk to Mark a Garden Layout
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Using Chalk to Mark a Garden Layout
passages.body:
**A** A gardener created a full-size plan by drawing proposed paths in chalk. Local users walked along the lines and suggested wider turns for wheelbarrows.

**B** The gardener left the lines in place over a weekend. Notes collected afterwards identified a place where two groups often tried to enter a gate from different directions.

**C** After adjusting the plan, the garden added a movable planter. It could be pushed away to make space for larger deliveries while keeping permanent walls in the same place.

questions.prompt: Local users walked along the lines and suggested wider turns for ______.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Local users walked along the lines and suggested wider turns for wheelbarrows.

questions.prompt: Notes collected afterwards identified a place where two groups often tried to enter a ______ from different directions.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Notes collected afterwards identified a place where two groups often tried to enter a gate from different directions.

questions.prompt: It could be pushed away to make space for larger ______ while keeping permanent walls in the same place.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: It could be pushed away to make space for larger deliveries while keeping permanent walls in the same place.

questions.prompt: The garden introduced an entry fee once the paths were finished.
questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage does not state this information.

questions.prompt: Which paragraph mentions a flexible feature that could be repositioned?
questions.explanation: After adjusting the plan, the garden added a movable planter. It could be pushed away to make space for larger deliveries while keeping permanent walls in the same place.
